name: Waikiki Beachcomber by Outrigger
positioning: Art-filled hotel in central Waikiki, officially the OUTRIGGER Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel, with a busy pool deck and its own Cirque du Soleil show
best_for: Travelers who want a lively Waikiki base steps from shopping and nightlife
Guests drawn to local art, live music and Hawaiian cultural activities

facts.text: Cirque du Soleil 'Auana, a Hawai'i-inspired production with acrobats, comedians, musicians, singers and hula dancers, is staged at the hotel.
Inside the hotel, guests are surrounded by ocean-inspired photography and art installations from the Beachcomber Originals.
The hotel offers Hawaiian art, artisan eats and locally made beer as a modern take on Oahu culture and hospitality.
The hotel is just steps from famous landmarks and the bustling nightlife of Waikiki.
Waikiki Beach Walk, with shops, dining and live music, is just steps from the hotel.
The hotel has live music daily from local artists.
Sunrise yoga is held on the pool deck every Wednesday and Saturday morning.
The Beachcomber Activities Lounge, a concierge desk on the lobby level, helps guests book Oahu activities from helicopter tours to paddleboarding.
Hawaiian Aroma Caffe is located right at the pool.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2023 and 2026.

highlights.text: Cirque du Soleil 'Auana, a Hawai'i-inspired show with acrobats and hula dancers, plays at the hotel.
Ocean-inspired photography and art installations from the Beachcomber Originals fill the hotel.
TOMA, the Terrace of Modern Art, is a free quarterly art program on the pool deck featuring local artists supporting local causes.
Complimentary Hawaiian cultural activities, from hula dancing to ukulele lessons, take place without leaving the hotel.
Poolside movies play every Saturday night under the stars on the open-air pool deck.

considerations.text: Pool cabanas are a rental; availability and pricing are handled at the front desk.
The hotel lists a Macy's store at street level and sits amid the bustling nightlife of Waikiki.
WhataHotel notes a high-traffic tourist area with busy surroundings.
